decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 26 P2), refusal first-class and reachable for every candidate; every definition is declared CHOSEN up front because validity-research.md names `happiness` and never defines it. G1 — the definition names the engine fields it reads. G2 — the KEEPER can move it, judged against the player's verbs (feed, play), the bar MEASURED as the smallest response any existing visible axis shows to those verbs, and the recomputed floor must reproduce the committed N5 floor exactly (instrument check — a mismatch raises instead of judging). G3 — care-coupled: a cherished life and a neglected life must separate on it. G4 — the label test: distress relieved by the keeper must RAISE the bar, else refuse_as_euphemism. G5 — distinct from what is shown: a per-tick identity with a readout already on the player's screen under another name earns refuse_as_duplicate, which OUTRANKS the euphemism verdict (the sharper accusation: nothing about the number is wrong, only the second name). Selection among eligible candidates: the LOWEST final reading on the neglected corpse wins (N5's refusal logic made into the selection statistic), ties to the definition reading fewer engine fields, then by name. At most one adoption; eligible non-winners are recorded eligible_not_selected. This module builds no UI.
decision.pre_run_prediction: Written before the run, so it can be wrong on the record: bond_rename is expected to pass G1–G4 and be REFUSED on G5 as a duplicate — its series is the shown bond readout's by construction, and one number may not wear two visible names. social_warmth is expected to be ELIGIBLE and SELECTED: a neglected companion's window empties, so the corpse reads 0.0 — the strongest honesty property available — while feed and play move it well over the floor. need_balance is the deliberate uncertainty, named in advance on two counts: its G2 response from a near-target start may fall under the floor (feeding an un-hungry creature moves the mean distance little), and if it is eligible its neglect-death reading is expected HIGH (~0.7 — a mean hides the killer axis, the exact property that made health a minimum), which the selection statistic penalizes. If adopted, social_warmth is additionally expected to RISE under play while the health readout falls — the property that makes happiness informative beside health, recorded as an observation, not a gate. If the measurement disagrees, the measurement wins.

next_research_step: Land the adopted readout in the game (same slice) with the mirror pinned against this artifact; record the decision as DR 0058; then P3, the cleanliness mechanic gate.
